goal: A parse_price function that turns "$1,299.00" into 1299.0 and passes every visible test, confirmed once on the hidden tests

steps.title: Read the spec and the visible tests
steps.proof: NOTES.md lists the 20 visible cases and the input formats they cover

steps.title: Implement parse_price
steps.proof: src/price.py imports cleanly and parse_price("$1.00") returns 1.0

steps.title: Run visible checks
steps.proof: `pytest tests/visible -q` pass count logged per round

steps.title: Repair the failures
steps.proof: The next visible run fails fewer tests

loops.until: Every visible test passes, or no improvement in two rounds
loops.heldOut: tests/held_out, run once by lead after the loop
